Commercial Property Types in the Fraser Valley | Jared Gibbons

parts.t: Browse commercial properties for sale and lease throughout the Fraser Valley, including South Surrey, Langley, Surrey, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, and surrounding communities. This page features up-to-date MLS® commercial listings, including industrial warehouses, office buildings, retail spaces, mixed-use developments, and investment properties.

Whether you are a business owner looking for a new location, an investor searching for income-producing real estate, or a developer exploring land and redevelopment opportunities, the Fraser Valley offers a wide range of commercial options. Popular commercial corridors include Campbell Heights, Highway 10, Highway 1, and major business parks throughout Langley and South Surrey.

Use the search tools below to filter by property type, zoning, size, or price. For detailed information, private tours, or expert guidance on commercial real estate in the Fraser Valley, connect with Jared Gibbons.

Commercial real estate across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver offers diverse investment opportunities from retail spaces to industrial warehouses, office buildings to mixed-use developments. These properties attract investors, business owners, and developers seeking income potential, business locations, or long-term appreciation in growing communities.  Review

The region's strong economic fundamentals, population growth, and improving infrastructure support various commercial sectors from neighborhood retail to logistics facilities. Available properties range from small owner-operator spaces perfect for local businesses to larger investment-grade buildings with multiple tenants generating stable income. Strategic locations near highways, transit, and population centers command premium pricing while emerging areas offer value with growth potential. Understanding zoning, tenant markets, capitalization rates, and local economic trends is essential for successful commercial investing. Whether you're seeking your first commercial property or expanding a portfolio, professional guidance maximizes returns. I can help identify opportunities matching your investment criteria—contact me for available commercial listings and recent sales data across property types.
